items.title: Marine Weather Statement issued May 18 at 7:20AM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
items.summary:
The areas affected include...
Nearshore waters from Wind Point WI TO Winthrop Harbor IL...
Lake Michigan from Port Washington WI to Winthrop Harbor IL...

At 719 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm, capable
of producing winds to around 30 knots and small hail. This
thunderstorm was located 9 nm southeast of Racine, moving northeast
at 45 knots.

The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters east of
Wind Point to Winthrop Harbor.
